runs.text: According to the text, the drugs in

that use lipid-based nanocarriers are Atu027, TKM-080301, DCR-MYC, NBF-006 and EphA2 siRNA. The text says these all utilize lipid-based nanocarriers, including lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), liposomes and DOPC.

The table's carrier column agrees: Atu027 is listed with liposomes, TKM-080301, DCR-MYC and NBF-006 with LNPs, and EphA2 siRNA with DOPC. The text does not assign the other drugs in the table, such as siG12D on a LODER polymer or the ligand-siRNA conjugates, to lipid-based nanocarriers.
